```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

require(plyr)
require(knitr)
require(ggplot2)
require(car)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}

items = c("know01","know02","know03","know04","know05","know06r","know07r","know08","know09","know10")
alldata <- read.csv("diabetes_myths_250.csv",header=TRUE)

mydata <- alldata[which(alldata$check==1),]
mydata$cond_myths <- as.factor(ifelse(mydata$condition=="myths_only" | mydata$condition=="myths_facts","myths","Qs"))
mydata$cond_facts <- as.factor(ifelse(mydata$condition=="Qs_facts" | mydata$condition=="myths_facts","Facts","noFacts"))
mydata$cond_interv <- ifelse(mydata$condition=="no_intervention",0,1)
mydata$know_score_bin <- rowMeans(ifelse(mydata[,items]>0,1,0)) # caclulates know_score based on 0,1 recoding of responses

summary(mydata$know_score_bin)
# mydata <- mydata[which(mydata$myths_facts_t > 120 | mydata$Qs_facts_t > 120 | mydata$cond_facts=="noFacts"),]

mydata$somediab <- as.factor(ifelse(mydata$diabetes==1|mydata$prediabetic==1,"Diabetic",0))
mydata$diab_status <- as.factor(ifelse(mydata$diabetes==1,"Diabetic",ifelse(mydata$prediabetic==1,"Prediabetic","Non-diabetic")))
mydata$diab_status <- factor(mydata$diab_status, levels=c("Non-diabetic","Prediabetic","Diabetic"))
```

## Diabetes knowledge Scale Confidence

```{r, include = FALSE}


corr_conf <- vector()

for (i in 1:nrow(mydata)) {

  conf = list()
  
  for (item in 19:28) {
    if (mydata[i,item] > 0) {
      conf <- c(conf,mydata[i,item]-1)
       
    }
  }
  corr_conf <- c(corr_conf,mean(as.numeric(conf)))

}

mydata$corr_conf <- corr_conf


wrong_conf <- vector()

for (i in 1:nrow(mydata)) {

  conf = list()
  
  for (item in 19:28) {
    if (mydata[i,item] < 0) {
      conf <- c(conf,-1*mydata[i,item]-1)
       
    }
  }
  wrong_conf <- c(wrong_conf,mean(as.numeric(conf)))

}

mydata$wrong_conf <- wrong_conf

```

# Inferential Statistics {.tabset}

## ANOVA on intervention groups

```{r}
anovadata <- mydata[which(mydata$condition!="no_intervention"),]
overall <- aov(lm(know_score_bin ~ cond_myths * cond_facts, data=anovadata))

summary(overall)
TukeyHSD(overall)

```

You can see it in the figure, but it's interesting that there's an interaction. Questions alone did not seem to harm people's responding, but questions and the facts did. Apparently the whole mess is just confusing for people.

In fact, changing the myths to questions in the long-form version with facts included didn't do anything!


## Comparing treatments against no intervention


```{r, echo=FALSE}
t.test(mydata[which(mydata$condition=="no_intervention"),"know_score_bin"],
       mydata[which(mydata$condition=="myths_only"),"know_score_bin"])

t.test(mydata[which(mydata$condition=="no_intervention"),"know_score_bin"],
       mydata[which(mydata$condition=="myths_facts"),"know_score_bin"])

t.test(mydata[which(mydata$condition=="no_intervention"),"know_score_bin"],
       mydata[which(mydata$condition=="Qs_only"),"know_score_bin"])

t.test(mydata[which(mydata$condition=="no_intervention"),"know_score_bin"],
       mydata[which(mydata$condition=="Qs_facts"),"know_score_bin"])

t.test(mydata[which(mydata$condition=="myths_only"),"know_score_bin"],
       mydata[which(mydata$condition=="myths_facts"),"know_score_bin"])

t.test(mydata[which(mydata$condition=="Qs_only"),"know_score_bin"],
       mydata[which(mydata$condition=="Qs_facts"),"know_score_bin"])
```

## Comparing Diabetic and non-diabetic participants

As expected, no difference between (pre)diabetic and non-diabetic participants (very few diabetic participants) in the effects of conditions.



```{r, echo=FALSE}

diab_v_non <- aov(lm(know_score_bin ~ cond_myths * cond_facts*somediab, data=anovadata))
summary(diab_v_non)


```

In addition, (pre)diabetic participants scored slightly higher than non-diabetic participants at baseline, but this effect was not significant. 

```{r, echo=F}

t.test(know_score_bin ~ somediab, data = mydata[which(mydata$condition=="no_intervention"),])
```

Finally, collapsing across all conditions, there was no difference in knowledge between (pre)diabetic and non-diabetic participants.

```{r, echo=F}

t.test(know_score_bin ~ somediab, data = mydata)

```
